svg.aria-label: Development farm: sandro gives specs and reviews; an orchestrator queues lots and dispatches them to sub-agents (architect: shapes the system, planner: splits it into lots, developer: writes the code, code-reviewer: reads every diff, verifier: proves it works); results ship to production. BRAIN // obsidian vault: decisions · pitfalls · learnings · project state, shared by every agent. each agent reads it before a task and writes back what it learned, so the farm never makes the same mistake twice.
